title: 富查伊拉 Vopak 碼頭
summary: 富查伊拉 Vopak 以產品管線連接港口歧管；本課將多客戶槽區、產品品質與出貨量測分開核對。本課依序分析多客戶可用槽容、產品批次混合指標、歧管路徑摩擦、租戶與總量對帳、鹽霧環境壁厚趨勢，每項都包含可重算模型、證據規劃、故障辨析與驗收成果。數字全部是教學假設；不宣稱本案例採用這些設備參數。
summaryEn: Vopak Horizon Fujairah connects to a port manifold through product lines; this case separates multi-user storage, quality and export metering. The course analyses usable capacity across customers, batch product blending indicator, friction along manifold routes, tenant-to-total reconciliation, thickness trends in a saline atmosphere, with recalculable models, evidence plans, fault discrimination and acceptance artifacts. All numbers are teaching assumptions; no plant-specific parameter is asserted.
scope: 本課以真實公開工程為情境，結合五個案例應用單元與五個明示共用的方法單元；原理與教學結構會跨課程重用。全部算例輸入均為合成教學假設，不代表場址實測、設計、保證或操作設定。任務為離線分析、守恆估算、資料檢核與失效推理，不是施工、開採、爆破、設備操作或作業許可。
scopeEn: Real public projects provide context for five case applications and five explicitly shared method units; physical methods and teaching structure are reused across courses. Every numerical input is a synthetic teaching assumption, not measured, design, guaranteed or operating data for the site. Tasks concern offline analysis, balances, data checking and failure reasoning, not construction, extraction, blasting, equipment operation or permits.
v31Focus: 多客戶可用槽容、產品批次混合指標、歧管路徑摩擦
v31FocusEn: Usable capacity across customers; Batch product blending indicator; Friction along manifold routes

quiz.question: 關於「多客戶可用槽容」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Usable capacity across customers" is correct?
options: 有效庫存是可動用容積而非銘牌總容積；最低底油、品質分槽及檢修隔離會減少緩衝量。
儲槽總容量就是隨時可用的產品庫存。
所有油品品質都能用體積比例做線性平均。
optionsEn: Usable inventory differs from nominal tank capacity because minimum heel, grade segregation and maintenance isolation remove available volume.
Nominal tank capacity equals immediately usable product inventory.
Every fuel property can be linearly averaged by volume fraction.
quiz.explanation: 有效庫存是可動用容積而非銘牌總容積；最低底油、品質分槽及檢修隔離會減少緩衝量。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Usable inventory differs from nominal tank capacity because minimum heel, grade segregation and maintenance isolation remove available volume. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 多客戶可用槽容：機制與資源流程
steps.titleEn: Usable capacity across customers: mechanism and resource flow
steps.objective: 說明「多客戶可用槽容」如何決定「富查伊拉 Vopak 碼頭」的物料、能量、量測或環境功能，並畫出輸入、轉換、損失與系統邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Usable capacity across customers” governs material, energy, measurement or environmental functions in “Vopak Horizon Fujairah terminal”, and map inputs, conversions, losses and the system boundary.
steps.instruction: 本案例的分析界面是「多客戶可用槽容」。富查伊拉 Vopak 以產品管線連接港口歧管；本課將多客戶槽區、產品品質與出貨量測分開核對。在「富查伊拉 Vopak 碼頭」的教學模型中，先把這個界面和相鄰設備分開，再使用下列方法。有效庫存是可動用容積而非銘牌總容積；最低底油、品質分槽及檢修隔離會減少緩衝量。把有效容積除以淨流出量可估算緩衝時間，但來船批量與出貨尖峰會讓平均天數不足以描述短時風險。 師傅任務：畫出這個單元的能量與物質流圖（輸入、轉換、損失、輸出、邊界），標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由資源、環境或運轉決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The case interface is “Usable capacity across customers”. Vopak Horizon Fujairah connects to a port manifold through product lines; this case separates multi-user storage, quality and export metering. In the teaching model for Vopak Horizon Fujairah terminal, separate this interface from adjacent equipment before applying the following method. Usable inventory differs from nominal tank capacity because minimum heel, grade segregation and maintenance isolation remove available volume. Dividing usable volume by net outflow gives buffer duration, but cargo batches and demand peaks mean an average duration cannot describe every short-term constraint. Mentor task: draw the energy and material flow of this unit (inputs, conversions, losses, outputs, boundary), mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by resource, environment or operation, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.title: 多客戶可用槽容：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Usable capacity across customers: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「多客戶可用槽容」的關鍵量，並判斷輸入改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantity of “Usable capacity across customers” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when an input moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：t = Vusable/Qnet；代入 V = 43050 m³ usable liquid、Q = 6000 m³/day net outflow，得 7.17 day（「多客戶可用槽容」的簡化算例；所有輸入皆為教學假設，不是本工程實測、銘牌、設計或操作設定。）。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次；再把 Q 增加 10%，先預測再計算輸出，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出設計或規範通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: t = Vusable/Qnet; with V = 43050 m³ usable liquid, Q = 6000 m³/day net outflow the result is 7.17 day (simplified exercise for Usable capacity across customers; every input is a teaching assumption, not measured, rated, design or operating data of this project.). Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units; then raise Q by 10%, predict before computing the output, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how designers or codes usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 敏感度核對：Q 增加 10% 時，結果變為 6.52 day（-9.1%）。
steps.observationEn: Sensitivity check: Raising Q by 10% changes the result to 6.52 day (-9.1%).
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成實機設計值、混淆額定值與實際運轉值，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as plant design values, mixing rated and actual operating values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later decisions.
steps.check: 重現 7.17 day（取整誤差 ±2% 內），並提交 Q 改變 10% 的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce 7.17 day (within ±2% rounding) and submit the sensitivity calculation for a 10% change in Q with an engineering explanation.

quiz.question: 要驗證「多客戶可用槽容」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Usable capacity across customers"?
options: 量測時不必記錄環境溫度、負載與運轉模式，因為它們不影響結果。
物料帳有差額就能立即斷定有實體洩漏。
針對「多客戶可用槽容」，建立帶有案例名稱與時間基準的證據表。
optionsEn: Ambient temperature, load and operating mode need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Any balance residual immediately proves a physical leak.
For “Usable capacity across customers”, create an evidence table identified by case and time basis.
quiz.explanation: 針對「多客戶可用槽容」，建立帶有案例名稱與時間基準的證據表。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: For “Usable capacity across customers”, create an evidence table identified by case and time basis. Verification needs a baseline, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 多客戶可用槽容：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Usable capacity across customers: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「多客戶可用槽容」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停留點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Usable capacity across customers” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 針對「多客戶可用槽容」，建立帶有案例名稱與時間基準的證據表。用逐時入出庫表積分庫存軌跡，先核對初末庫存守恆，再找出最高與最低值，不能只報日平均庫存。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器、基準或校正、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停留點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: For “Usable capacity across customers”, create an evidence table identified by case and time basis. Integrate hourly receipts and deliveries into an inventory trajectory, verify opening-to-closing balance, and identify extrema rather than reporting only average daily stock. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments, baseline or calibration, procedure, comparison, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：成果檔以 062-01 標記，圖表須寫明「富查伊拉 Vopak 碼頭：教學假設」。交付有效容積分解表、收發事件表及最短緩衝時間，並註明不包含消防或應變設計。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Label the output 062-01 and mark charts “Vopak Horizon Fujairah terminal: teaching assumptions”. Deliver the usable-capacity breakdown, receipt/delivery schedule and minimum buffer time; this exercise does not specify emergency or fire-protection design.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：「多客戶可用槽容」的錯誤會傳遞到相鄰系統，因此要先定位偏差來源。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境與運轉條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: An error at “Usable capacity across customers” propagates to adjacent systems, so locate its origin first. A single reading, no traceable baseline, or unrecorded ambient and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停留點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, baseline, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.questionEn: When "Usable capacity across customers" shows an anomaly, which diagnosis is most reasonable?

所有異常都是操作人員失誤，設計、製造與維護不需要檢討。
所有油品品質都能用體積比例做線性平均。
optionsEn: An error at “Usable capacity across customers” propagates to adjacent systems, so locate its origin first.
Every anomaly is operator error, so design, manufacturing and maintenance never need review.
Every fuel property can be linearly averaged by volume fraction.

steps.title: 多客戶可用槽容：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Usable capacity across customers: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「多客戶可用槽容」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or degradation causes of “Usable capacity across customers” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 「多客戶可用槽容」的錯誤會傳遞到相鄰系統，因此要先定位偏差來源。把已預留給別種產品的槽容算入可用容量，會讓紙上緩衝時間過長；液位計偏差也可能使帳面與實際庫存無法閉合。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢查，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響「富查伊拉 Vopak 碼頭」的安全、交付、壽命或環境。
steps.instructionEn: An error at “Usable capacity across customers” propagates to adjacent systems, so locate its origin first. Counting tanks reserved for another grade inflates the apparent buffer; level-gauge bias can likewise prevent book inventory from closing against physical stock. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects safety, delivery, life or environment of “Vopak Horizon Fujairah terminal”.

knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢查確認；只更換設備、重設警報或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; swapping equipment, resetting alarms or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

knowledge.title: 證據版本
knowledge.text: 2026-11-10：核對官方工程識別與公開情境；算例由作者設定為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: 2026-11-10: Primary project identity and public context reviewed; numerical examples are authored teaching assumptions.
